# Lightroom Classic SDK

This directory intentionally contains no committed SDK payload. The Adobe
Lightroom Classic SDK is copyrighted material and must be downloaded by an
authorized Adobe customer from the Adobe Developer Console. Do not commit or
redistribute it unless a later license review establishes that permission.

For local development:

1. Download the newest Lightroom Classic SDK available to your Adobe account.
2. Place the downloaded ZIP in this directory.
3. Extract it into a versioned subdirectory, such as `15.3/`.

ZIP files and extracted SDK contents in this directory are ignored by Git. This
README is tracked so a fresh checkout explains why the directory is otherwise
empty.
